entities.summary: Sukanta Bhattacharya was a Bengali poet. He was called "Young Nazrul" and Kishore Bidrohi Kobi, a reference to Kazi Nazrul Islam, for his similar rebellious stance against the British Raj and the social elites through the work of poetry.
